_doc: M1.1 PROPOSAL: additions to content/default/combat.json (combat designer, docs/design/_drafts/m1.1/combat-skills.md). Merge: append `attributes`, `statModStats`; add the new top-level blocks; extend the closed vocabularies in core/content.

attributesAppend.name: Stamina
attributesAppend.description: Staying power: how many rounds and matches a fighter can play before tiring. It acts only through Freshness (lifecycle); it has no effect during a fight.
usedFor: freshness drain per round played and recovery between weeks (lifecycle)

freshness._doc: Per-fighter freshness 0-100 arrives in each round input (lifecycle owns drain per round played, recovery and labels). Severity s = clamp((thresholdBelow - F) / (thresholdBelow - fullPenaltyAtOrBelow), 0, 1) from the freshness at the start of that round; fixed for the whole round. Each penalty = penaltyAtFull x s x (1 - fatigueResist).
freshness.labelsFrom: levels.json freshness.labels (fresh >= 80, ready >= 60, tired >= 40, spent < 40); reports tag a fighter Tired or Spent with the penalty applied

fightInputAppend.enteredThisRound: bool: the fighter entered from the reserves (or as an emergency entrant) for this round

match._doc: sys-match (M1.1): match squads and swaps. Owner rules: squad of 5 starters + 2 reserves; at most 2 swaps per match, between rounds only; a fighter swapped out cannot return in that match (owner ruling 2026-10-26).

swaps.between: rounds only (never before round 1, never after the deciding round)
swaps.decision: simultaneous and blind; applied home then away
swaps.injuryReplacement: forced; an unused reserve enters and uses a swap; with none left an emergency entrant enters without a swap
swaps.emergencyEntrant: best-fit fit roster fighter outside the match squad (same role family, then rating, then freshness, then fighter id); else a hired blade
